name: Mueller Regional Retail Center
summary: Mueller Regional Retail Center is a fully-leased 357,088 square foot retail destination within Austin's acclaimed 700-acre Mueller mixed-use redevelopment. Strategically located near University of Texas and downtown Austin, the center serves a thriving community anchored by Dell Children's Hospital, 5,700 homes, and complementary commercial developments.
demographics: Mueller Regional Retail Center attracts a diverse, affluent demographic with a median household income of $96,765 within a 1-mile radius and $90,469 within 10 miles. The trade area serves a well-educated population drawn from the nearby University of Texas and downtown Austin professionals, with significant daytime population influx reaching over 1.3 million within 10 miles. The center benefits from its integration within the larger Mueller mixed-use development featuring 5,700 new homes, Dell Children's Hospital, and Austin Film Studios, creating a family-oriented customer base with above-average spending power. Primary visitors include young professionals, families with children, and healthcare workers who value convenience and quality retail options in Austin's rapidly growing urban core.
description: Mueller Regional Retail Center represents the premier retail component of Austin's transformative 700-acre Mueller Airport redevelopment project, one of the largest urban infill developments in the United States. Strategically positioned near the University of Texas and downtown Austin, this 357,088 square foot shopping destination has rapidly evolved into a major retail hub within the Austin-Round Rock-Georgetown metropolitan area. The center benefits from exceptional synergy with complementary developments including Dell Children's Hospital and research campus, Austin Film Studios, hospitality facilities, and a thriving residential community of 5,700 homes, all sharing integrated access points and parking facilities. Currently fully leased with a waitlist for future availability, Mueller Regional Retail Center demonstrates strong market demand and tenant confidence in this dynamic mixed-use environment. The property's success reflects Austin's robust economic growth and the Mueller development's vision of creating a vibrant, walkable urban neighborhood that seamlessly blends retail, healthcare, entertainment, and residential uses.
